web-api.description: ASP.NET Core Web API controllers serving as the HTTP presentation layer.

required_patterns.controller-base-class: All controllers inherit from ControllerBase and use [ApiController] attribute.
required_patterns.route-convention: Routes use [Route("api/{resource-name}")] with kebab-case resource names.
required_patterns.mediator-dispatch: Controllers do not call repositories directly. All business logic is dispatched via IMessageBus (Wolverine) using InvokeAsync<TResult>.
required_patterns.constructor-injection: Controllers receive dependencies through constructor injection using expression-bodied constructors.

architectural_constraints.no-direct-repository-access: Controllers must NOT inject or use repository interfaces directly — they must go through Wolverine IMessageBus.
architectural_constraints.no-business-logic: Controllers contain zero business logic; they only map HTTP requests to CQRS messages and return results.
architectural_constraints.api-prefix: All API endpoints are prefixed with 'api/'.

cqrs-messaging.description: CQRS pattern implemented via Wolverine mediator for in-process query/command handling.

required_patterns.static-handler-class: Handler classes are static classes with a static Handle method.
required_patterns.handler-method-signature: The Handle method takes the query/command object as the first parameter, followed by dependencies (repositories, services) that Wolverine resolves via DI.
required_patterns.message-types: Query classes are plain C# classes with public get/set properties. Result types are C# records.
required_patterns.dto-mapping: Handlers map domain entities to DTOs before returning results. DTOs are defined alongside the handler.

architectural_constraints.wolverine-discovery: Handlers must be in assemblies whose names start with 'Roman.RedisManager' to be auto-discovered.
architectural_constraints.mediator-only: Wolverine is configured in MediatorOnly mode — no durable messaging or external transport.

domain-model.description: Core domain entities and repository interfaces — the innermost layer with no external dependencies.

required_patterns.entity-encapsulation: Entity properties use 'internal set' or 'protected set' to restrict mutation to the domain layer.
required_patterns.primary-constructors: Simple entities use C# primary constructors (e.g., RedisKey(string key)).
required_patterns.traditional-constructors: Complex entities use explicit constructors with parameter assignment.
required_patterns.computed-properties: Derived/computed properties use expression-bodied getters (e.g., HasMoreResults).
required_patterns.repository-interface-location: Repository interfaces live in Domain/Repositories/ and return domain entities.

architectural_constraints.no-external-dependencies: The Domain project has zero NuGet package references — only framework types.
architectural_constraints.no-infrastructure-concerns: Domain entities must not reference StackExchange.Redis, configuration, or ASP.NET types.
architectural_constraints.immutable-after-construction: Entity state is set via constructors; setters are internal/protected.

data-layer.description: Infrastructure implementations of repository interfaces using StackExchange.Redis and Options pattern.

required_patterns.repository-pattern: Each repository class implements an interface from Domain/Repositories/.
required_patterns.constructor-injection: Repositories receive dependencies (IConnectionMultiplexer, IOptions<T>) via constructor injection.
required_patterns.null-guard: Constructor parameters are validated with null-checks (throw ArgumentNullException).
required_patterns.domain-entity-mapping: Repository methods return domain entity types, not Redis-specific types.

architectural_constraints.infrastructure-only-redis: StackExchange.Redis types (IConnectionMultiplexer, IServer, etc.) are confined to the Infrastructure project.
architectural_constraints.options-pattern: Configuration is injected via IOptions<RedisConfiguration>, not read directly from IConfiguration.
architectural_constraints.di-registration: Repository implementations are registered in Program.cs as singletons.

configuration.description: Strongly-typed configuration classes validated via data annotations, bound from appsettings.json.

required_patterns.section-name-constant: Root configuration classes define a const string SectionName for the config section key.
required_patterns.required-properties: Properties use the 'required' modifier for mandatory settings.
required_patterns.validation-on-start: Configuration is validated at startup via ValidateDataAnnotations() and ValidateOnStart().

architectural_constraints.cross-layer-namespace: Configuration classes physically live in Infrastructure/Configuration/ but use the namespace Roman.RedisManager.Web.Configuration.
architectural_constraints.no-secrets-in-config: Credentials (User, Password) are nullable optional properties; sensitive values should use external secret stores.
architectural_constraints.flat-binding: Configuration maps directly to a JSON section — no custom binders.

testing.description: Unit and integration tests using xUnit and Shouldly assertion library.

required_patterns.xunit-facts: Tests use [Fact] attribute (no [Theory] parameterized tests currently).
required_patterns.shouldly-assertions: Assertions use Shouldly methods (ShouldNotBeNull, ShouldNotBeEmpty, ShouldAllBe, ShouldContain).
required_patterns.arrange-act-assert: Tests follow AAA pattern: create repository with real or configured dependencies, call method, assert.
required_patterns.helper-methods: Shared test data is created via private helper methods (e.g., GetConfiguration()).
required_patterns.global-usings: Xunit and Shouldly are imported via GlobalUsings.cs.

architectural_constraints.test-project-references: Test project references Domain and Infrastructure only — not Web or Application.
architectural_constraints.no-mocking-framework: No mocking library (Moq, NSubstitute) is used; tests use real implementations with configured options.
architectural_constraints.integration-style: RedisRepositoryTests require a live Redis connection; RedisServerRepositoryTests use in-memory configuration.

extensions.description: Reusable extension method utilities in a standalone project.

required_patterns.static-extension-class: Extension methods are in static classes named {Type}Extensions.
required_patterns.single-responsibility: Each extension class focuses on one type (e.g., StringExtensions for string).
required_patterns.global-using-import: Extension namespaces are imported via GlobalUsings.cs in consuming projects.

architectural_constraints.no-external-dependencies: Extensions project has zero NuGet dependencies — framework-only.
architectural_constraints.pure-functions: Extension methods are pure functions with no side effects or state.
